steps.en: OCMS sends the company's UEN to the government data source
steps.id: OCMS mengirim UEN perusahaan ke sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The lookup exists but is switched off in production, and the data source name is unconfirmed.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ada tapi dimatikan di produksi, dan nama sumber datanya belum bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: OCMS receives and updates the company's name and address
steps.id: OCMS menerima dan memperbarui nama serta alamat perusahaan
steps.why_en: The update logic exists but its job is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Logika pembaruan ada, tapi job-nya dimatikan di produksi.

steps.en: OCMS receives the owner, partner and director details
steps.id: OCMS menerima data pemilik, partner, dan director
steps.why_en: The details are fetched but not saved, and the fetching job is off in production.
steps.why_id: Datanya diambil tapi tidak disimpan, dan job pengambilnya dimatikan di produksi.

steps.en: The person is chosen by the offence date and appointment period
steps.id: Orangnya dipilih berdasarkan tanggal pelanggaran dan masa jabatan
steps.why_en: No logic compares the offence date with the appointment dates; the screen shows the latest record.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika yang membandingkan tanggal pelanggaran dengan tanggal jabatan; layar menampilkan data terbaru.

steps.en: OCMS follows up the notice against the chosen person
steps.id: OCMS menindaklanjuti notice terhadap orang yang terpilih
steps.why_en: Nothing makes the chosen person the offender; staff would have to do it by hand.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menjadikan orang terpilih sebagai offender; staf harus melakukannya manual.
